issues.detail: Welcome galley glass cabinet: too narrow, 0.33 m clear of the screen, pane now too dark
issues.problem: In both real photos the glass-door cabinet is a large unit about 0.7x the monitor's width. It abuts the monitor (about 2-3 cm of tower between them) and its top is level with the monitor top, with the white tag above. To its right the tower's dark side return shows before the pale recess wall. In the render the cabinet is 0.44 m against the 0.90 m screen (0.49x), with a 0.33 m blank charcoal wall between them, and its top sits below the screen top. With the w12 tint the pane is darker than the tower (0.8x), where the photo has 1.1x, so it reads as a hole rather than glass.
issues.evidence: w12/m03_welcome.png: screen x 118-455, blank gap 455-580, cabinet 580-760 (y 147-455), screen top y 112. omaat_room_32.jpg: screen x 360-680, cabinet 700-945 (gap about 20 px), cabinet top y 120 against screen top y 130. lalf_134.jpg: screen 665-870, cabinet 890-1035, tower side 1040-1240. Pane: m03 (610,210,720,430) #2c2628 against omaat (750,200,900,700) #3d3a35 and lalf_134 #514446; tower m03 (460,150,570,300) #393631 against omaat (700,450,725,700) #343025.
issues.fix: 10_mono.js buildWelcomeGalley l.374-386. Widen and move the cabinet. Its left edge should sit at the screen's right edge plus 0.03 m (screen right = mc + 0.45 = 0.27, so 0.30) with a width of 0.62: set gc so that gc + 0.02 = 0.61 (gc = 0.59). Scale every 0.40/0.38/0.44/0.34/0.166/0.195 width term by 0.62/0.44 (back panel 0.58, shelves 0.56, stiles at ±0.285, rails 0.64, bead verticals at ±0.245, bead horizontals 0.49) and spread the box list across ±0.22. Raise the top: top rail centre 1.89 (screen top 1.95) and pane bead top 1.82, keeping the bottom at 1.065. Interior tone back up about 1.35x: back panel '#463c3e' -> '#5a4e50', shelves '#6a6062' -> '#7e7476', boxes x1.3. Target pane mean about #3f3a3a (1.1x tower), p90 about #5e5658. The 0.18 m left between the cabinet and the recess wall (0.92-1.10) becomes the tower's side return in welcomeChar, as in lalf_134.

issues.detail: Brewer pot faceted; bay grey not black; small handle
issues.problem: Each of the 12 lathe wedges carries one flat colour, so the pot shows 12 vertical bands and reads as a fluted or faceted vessel. The real pots are smooth with one broad soft reflection. The real brewer bays are black inside bright steel cheeks; the render's are grey (head colour). The loop handle is a small nub.
issues.evidence: /tmp/claude-0/crops/w12_m09_brew.png (2x crop of w12/m09 450-700, 200-420): banded pots. sansY_44.jpg (650-990, 60-250) and sans_38.jpg (660-830, 170-300): smooth pots, black bay interiors, big black handle loop.
issues.fix: 10_mono.js brewer() l.198-200: use 36 wedges (i < 36, step PI/18) so the colour steps fall below pixel scale at 930 px. Better still, bake the colour per vertex on one gLathe(prof, 36) if Builder supports per-vertex colour. Bay back l.192 and the side cheeks l.193: the back stays bevBlack, add an inner black liner gBox(uW - 0.02, 0.19, 0.003) at oo 0.004, and make the cheeks steelBright. Handle l.203: a loop radius about 0.045 standing 0.035 proud of r, tube radius 0.008.

issues.problem: Every real insert and compartment face sits in a raised aluminium frame with rivets. Carts have recessed grip handles and riveted channel posts between them. The render's faces are frameless rounded slabs, which makes every galley read clean-CG.
issues.evidence: sans_38.jpg frames (160-450, 0-270) #8a8578 against face #a29d8c; grips (670-725, 650-690); posts (530-560, 745-765, y 560-900). w12/m12_rearGalley.png carts (620-760, 400-575) and aft wall (305-635, 125-345) are frameless; w12/m01 and m09 inserts are frameless.
issues.fix: 10_mono.js buildGalley: per insert or compartment face, four MONMAT.steelDark bars (0.014 wide, 0.008 proud) at o + 0.045, and two rows of 0.004 m steel dots. Per cart, a gRBox(0.12, 0.03, 0.01, 0.01, 1) steel grip 0.12 m below the top and a gBox(0.025, cartH, 0.03) steel post between carts. The same frames go round the 6 aft-wall stowage doors in m12.

issues.fix: 10_mono.js buildAshWall l.416: pw = Math.min(0.48, w/n - 0.16), so the flaps are spaced. Frame material { c: '#a39e96', r: 0.3, m: 0.6, l: LAYER.brushed } (warm-neutral; check MONMAT.steel for a blue tint). Lower the ash grain gain on barAsh for this wall, or use the faint-grain ashDoor layer 30 that the room worker added.
